Reading · Unit 3
Sunday is cleaning day.
Mom cleans the kitchen.
Dad cleans the living room.
My sister cleans the bedrooms.
Oh no! I have to clean the bathroom.

I have gloves and a sponge.
I clean the sink.
Splash, splash.
It is done.

I clean the shower.
Squeak, squeak.
It is done.

I clean the toilet.
Scrub, scrub.
It is done.

Now the bathroom smells like lemons.
“Good job,” says Mom.
She kisses my head.
“You smell like lemons too!” says Mom.
1. When is cleaning day?
(A) Monday
(B) Friday
(C) Saturday
(D) Sunday
2. Who cleans the living room?
(A) Mom
(B) Dad
(C) My sister
(D) I
3. What do I use to clean?
(A) a mop and a bucket
(B) gloves and a sponge
(C) a brush and soap
(D) towels and water
4. Why do I smell like lemons at the end?
(A) I ate a lemon.
(B) I took a shower.
(C) I drank lemon juice.
(D) I cleaned the bathroom.

[SP/FA] Hepta 2 Monthly Test 2 Review Sheet
Reading · Unit 4
Judy and Kelly are best friends.
They both play sports.
Judy is a runner.
Kelly is a soccer player.

Judy stretches before the race.
Kelly bounces the ball before the game.
They are ready to start.
One, two, three — go!

Judy runs fast around the track.
She wins the race.
Kelly kicks the ball far.
She scores the winning goal.

Judy gets a medal.
Kelly gets a trophy.
Judy is happy for Kelly.
Kelly is happy for Judy.
The best friends are sports champions.
1. What is the best title for the story?
(A) How to Play Soccer
(B) Two Best Friends and Sports
(C) A Day at the Park
(D) Judy’s New Running Shoes
2. What sport does Judy play?
(A) soccer
(B) running
(C) tennis
(D) swimming
3. What does Kelly do before the game?
(A) She stretches.
(B) She sleeps.
(C) She bounces the ball.
(D) She eats a snack.
4. How do Judy and Kelly feel at the end?
(A) sad
(B) angry
(C) tired
(D) happy

[SP/FA] Hepta 2 Monthly Test 2 Review Sheet
Reading · Unit 5
It is hot, dry, and windy in the desert.
But many animals live in the desert.
How do they live in the desert?

The desert is hot.
Scorpions sleep during the hot day.
They hunt during the cool night.

The desert is dry.
Gazelles do not need to drink water.
They get water from their food.

The desert is windy.
Camels have long eyelashes.
The eyelashes keep sand out of their eyes.

What other desert animals are there?
What is special about them?
1. What is the main idea of the story?
(A) why deserts are so windy
(B) how animals live in the desert
(C) where scorpions sleep at night
(D) why camels have long legs
2. What do scorpions do during the hot day?
(A) They sleep.
(B) They hunt for food.
(C) They drink a lot of water.
(D) They play in the sand.
3. Which is true about gazelles in the desert?
(A) They need to drink a lot of water.
(B) They sleep during the cool night.
(C) They get water by eating food.
(D) They hunt other desert animals.
4. Why do camels have long eyelashes?
(A) to stay cool during the day
(B) to look for food in the desert
(C) to keep sand out of their eyes
(D) to live without drinking water
